messages:
Alex (Sales): Heads up — ACME POC legal just dropped a SIG/CAIQ + DSAR batch. They want: 1) our DPA / SCC stance for EU data, 2) how DSARs are handled Hosted vs Dedicated, 3) whether DSAR responses or bulk deletions trigger extra fees. Also asked for a CAIQ mapping to upload to their vendor portal. Can we get short copyable answers + any CAIQ snippet?

Maria (Privacy): I can take DPA + DSAR language. Short: we provide a standard DPA that includes SCCs as an addendum for EU transfers. For Hosted we act as processor under the DPA; for Dedicated we can add residency and contractual controls per customer. DSARs: we process requests on behalf of customers (processor role) and assist with export/deletion within agreed SLAs. For deletion workflows we can provide export packages and deletion confirmation.

Maria (Privacy): Quick pasteable blurb you can send to legal: 
"We execute our Standard Data Processing Agreement which includes the EU Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. Redwood Inference acts as a data processor and will implement deletion and export operations on request in accordance with the DPA timelines. For Dedicated or Private deployments additional controls (KMS/HSM, in-region data residency) can be contractually stipulated."

Devon (Security): On the CAIQ/SIG side: we have a completed SIG self-assessment and a CAIQ export. Common gaps buyers ask about: KMS/HSM integration for Private, retention & deletion SLAs, access control & least privilege, pentest cadence and bug-bounty. I can produce a condensed mapping like:
- SIG:KeyMgmt -> KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure KeyVault)
- SIG:DataRetention -> Retention config + deletion confirmation API
- SIG:LoggingAccess -> RBAC + audit logs (90d default)
I'll attach a trimmed CSV for their portal (sending in thread). Also note: SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA.

Sam (SRE): For engineering specifics to include in CAIQ/answers: hosted platform retention defaults: request logs 30d, model cache / prefix cache ~7d, customer data retention depends on model usage and opt-outs. Embeddings or stored artifacts are kept only if customer opts in to storage for features like similarity search — otherwise ephemeral. For Dedicated we can set retention via config or contract. Sample retention snippet you can paste:

```
retention_defaults:
  request_logs_days: 30
  prefix_cache_days: 7
  embeddings_storage: optional (enabled by customer)
  deletion_endpoint: /admin/v1/customers/{id}/erase
```

Priya (AE): Pricing note: Standard DSAR support (routing requests, providing exports, deletion confirmation) is included as part of the platform for normal usage. Engineering-level bulk forensic work or emergency on-call triage is billable (hourly or via a pre-purchased support pack). For the POC we usually offer a one-time 8-hour compliance support credit to cover small deletion/export requests — helps unblock legal.

Alex (Sales): @Priya good call. Maria/Devon — can each of you give a 2-paragraph answer we can paste into their portal + the trimmed CAIQ CSV? Sales needs copy <=2 paragraphs each. Also confirm SOC2 under NDA.

Maria (Privacy): Will draft a 2-paragraph DPA/DSAR response and paste DPA link. ETA 30m.

Devon (Security): I'll export CAIQ CSV and a 1-page mapping table. Will also note SOC2 availability under NDA. ETA 45m.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #12345 - ACME POC SIG/DPA/DSAR - assignees: Maria (Privacy), Devon (Security) - due 2024-09-15

Alex (Sales): Perfect — once we have the blobs I'll upload to their vendor portal and reply. :thumbsup:
